Achieve All-in-One Clarity

Scattered accounts create headaches for business owners. By designing a unified financial flow with Sequence, you're putting an end to the juggling act. Integrate your accounts within our intuitive system, optimize your cash flow, and track every dollar with zero hassle.

Move Money Effortlessly

Tracking your money is great. Moving it effortlessly is even better. From smart automations to manual transfers, Sequence is action-oriented - bringing your financial strategies to life and making sure your dollars are exactly where you want them to be.

Reach Your Goals

Design a financial flow that fits your goals like a glove. Whether you are saving money for taxes, managing expenses, or on the cusp of reaching your next exciting milestone - with Sequence, your finances are set up to work for you.

Separate by Goal. Spend with Precision.

Pod for Every Goal
Think of Pods as mini bank accounts you create for your goals: taxes, savings, payroll, expenses - so nothing gets mixed.

Card for Every Pod
Each Pod can issue its own debit card, virtual or physical. Use the right card for the right spend. No more mixing.

One Card. Full Control
‍The Omni Card, a single physical card that lets you select which Pod to charge before you tap, so you can manage spending without carrying multiple cards.

Here's what you can do with Sequence:

Debt Repayment

Deploy tools that kick different repayment strategies into action

Tax Automation

Set aside funds to ensure compliance and reduce due date stress.

Debit Cards

Every pod links to a card, ensuring financial strategy alignment.

Smart Expense Management

Stay on top of your spending habits with automatic tracking.

Virtual Bank Accounts

Organize money into unlimited pods for budgeting, saving, or paying off debt.

Real-Time Cash Flow Tracking

Follow the money at all times with live insights.
